apple_silicon_install_upgrade.evidence: Universal DMG and arm64 slice were inspected on an Apple Silicon Mac. Installing and upgrading the app on a real Apple Silicon system was not tested.

intel_install_upgrade.evidence: The x86_64 slice cross-builds and targets macOS 13.0. No physical Intel Mac installation or upgrade was tested.

macos_13.evidence: Both executable slices declare macOS 13.0 as their minimum. Runtime behavior on macOS 13 was not tested.

visual_keyboard_voiceover.evidence: Automated UI regression tests passed. A complete visual, keyboard, and VoiceOver review of the 1.1.0 app was not performed.

real_soc_print_queue_cancel.evidence: No live SoC print, queue, or cancellation operation was performed during this validation.

keychain_account_switching.evidence: Keychain integration has automated coverage, but real account switching and credential retrieval after app restart were not observed.

real_soc_jump_enrollment_preservation.evidence: A read-only live check confirmed the app-selected managed key is registered alongside one other key. The corrected authentication flow reached stu through sjump. No registrations were changed during this check; app-driven enrollment preservation was not independently executed during this diagnosis.

managed_key_passphrase_keychain_restart.evidence: A new diagnostic process unlocked the app-selected encrypted managed key using its fingerprint-scoped passphrase from Keychain and verified jump access. A complete app restart and enrollment workflow was not observed.

maintainer_attestation.testing_statement: Automated release checks passed; device-specific and live SoC checks below are explicitly marked incomplete.
maintainer_attestation.publication_authorization: The maintainer requested publication of v1.1.0 using the existing ad-hoc distribution method.
maintainer_attestation.coverage_note: No physical Intel or macOS 13 test, full visual/accessibility review, live print smoke test, app-driven SoC enrollment preservation check, or managed-key Keychain restart test is claimed. The supplied manual registration transcript is recorded as context, not as app validation.

automated_checks.native_pdf_bridge_frontend_tests: passed; native PDF/bridge checks and 34 UI tests passed
automated_checks.website_tests: passed; 3 tests passed, including removal of the Available now badge

automated_checks.dependency_scan: govulncheck: 0 reachable findings and 0 findings in imported packages; GO-2026-5932 affects unmaintained golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, which is not imported or called

automated_checks.local_launch: not verified; a prior isolated launch attempt aborted with SIGABRT in the sandbox

live_jump_authentication.baseline: The selected app-managed key was accepted with public-key partial success, then the jump server requested password authentication. The previous key-only check could not complete.
live_jump_authentication.fixed_flow: The selected key was accepted first, the saved SoC password completed the required next step, and the same jump session successfully authenticated to stu.
live_jump_authentication.credential_handling: Password and encrypted-key passphrase were retrieved inside the diagnostic process from Keychain. No credential values were logged.
live_jump_authentication.scope: Observed on the current NUS/SoC connection. The alternate campus network was not separately retested.
